name: trellis-automation-simplification
title: Simplify Trellis execution and review automation
description: Remove the Codex executor/reviewer routing state machine (surface detection, host_routes, provider dispatch modes, provider-specific workflow-state) from Trellis core; establish a simple automatic execution + independent review loop with current-conversation default executor, generic reviewer target, snapshotted unit authorization, auto-advance, bounded auto-remediation, and no auto-archive.
scope: Trellis infrastructure only: .trellis scripts/hooks/config/workflow/spec/tests and .codex hooks. No MosDNS runtime code, Cargo manifests, WebUI, DNS behavior, Phase 5A benchmark semantics, production wiring, or deployment.
creator: tom
notes: Planning-only phase. Baseline HEAD at planning time: 1489ebf41975bf0ab836b2592060aa9d16905b36. Awaiting external root reviewer PASS before task.py start.
